title: Chamanzar2020: Ultra high-density EEG of interictal migraine and controls during visual, auditory stimulation and rest
description: Ultra high-density EEG (128 channels, custom cap with ~14 mm spacing over occipital, parietal and frontal areas) recorded from 18 individuals with migraine during the interictal period and 21 healthy controls. Tasks comprised steady-state visual evoked potentials (flickering gratings at 4 or 6 Hz), steady-state auditory evoked potentials (amplitude-modulated tones at 4 or 6 Hz), and eyes-open resting state. The data support analyses of abnormal cortical coherence patterns in migraine.
methods_description: Recorded with a 128-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz (24-bit) inside a Faraday cage, with auxiliary EOG, ECG, GSR, respiration, plethysmography and temperature channels. SSVEP and SSAEP stimuli were presented for 2 s (100 trials per frequency) with 1-1.5 s ISI, with about 10% attention trials requiring a key press; resting state was eyes open with a fixation cross in 2-min blocks.
